== Biography ==

Dinah is Alice's pet cat—a quiet, dear creature of gentle disposition. She sits comfortably by the fire, purring softly whilst she grooms herself, licking her paws and washing her face with patient attention. She is renowned for her skill as a mouser, a capital one for catching mice, and possesses a soft, pleasant nature that makes her delightful to hold and nurse.

Alice cherishes Dinah dearly and misses her greatly while lost in Wonderland, wishing she might be present to fetch things back or deal with vexing situations. She speaks of Dinah with eager affection to the creatures she meets, praising her pet's admirable qualities. Even in dreams, Alice walks hand in hand with Dinah, conversing with her most earnestly and asking whether she has ever eaten a bat.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — friend. Alice appears deeply attached to Dinah; she misses her during her adventures in Wonderland and frequently speaks of her pet with warmth and affection.
